summary: The initial universe for the index includes companies that, according to GICS classifications, belong to one of the following industries or sub-industries: (a) Industrial REITs, (b) Office REITs, (c) Real Estate Management & Development, (d) Specialized REITs, (e) Ground Transportation, (f) Air Freight & Logistics, (g) Transportation Infrastructure, or (h) Marine Transportation. The fund will invest all, or substantially all, of its assets in the component securities that make up the index. It is non-diversified.
